name: WP Speed Core
changelog:
v1.6.7:
- Frontend Gutenberg Bloat Suppressor: auto dequeue & de-register heavy block editor scripts/styles on public non-editor pages (eliminating 12s+ render-blocking).
- Dual-Layer Auto-Defer Fallback: automatically inject 'defer' on head scripts skipped from delayed execution to prevent parser locking.
- Autoplay Video Throttler: throttle autoplay WebM/MP4 videos (chat bubble widgets) until first user interaction event.
- Cloudflare Edge Cache-Control Header Synchronization: explicitly send no-cache on MISS and public max-age=14400 on HIT to prevent caching unprimed MISS responses at edge.
